title: The Event Horizon Telescope's 2019 M87 image
summary: The collaboration's first M87 paper presents an image of the shadow of that galaxy's central black hole.
body: The Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration's 2019 paper "First M87 Event Horizon Telescope Results. I. The Shadow of the Supermassive Black Hole" reports the image of the compact object in Messier 87. The claim to retrieve is the collaboration's published imaging result, not a photograph in the ordinary camera sense and not a view of a singularity.
